en: The day has come to visit the Lapis Market in preparation for the tea party. But the market feels strangely subdued. What could have happened?
After being pulled into a strange mirror, you come to in a world where everything is transparent. What happened in this world?
Gathering these troublesome witches is no easy task, but it must be done to prevent the garden from collapsing. Gather the witches and have a tea party!
What's going on with Fiena? It's like she's an entirely different witch. Is it really even her?
Abigail is almost completely ignorant about anything that happens outside of her farm. This first outing will be an important first step in learning about the wider world...
A suspicious invitation from Rims & Berry... What could they be planning this time? Can they be relied on to host a proper tea party?
Years of accumulated grievances and anger threaten the continuation of the tea parties. Perhaps protecting the garden requires being a little more shameless.
As the garden grew alongside Nahatra, it began to attract more and more witches. However, this caused an unforeseen problem...
All the tasks in the swamp have been dealt with, but the nightmare left behind by the contaminated seed still lingers. Test your limits as you eliminate the enemies remaining in the swamp.
The search for the Jewel Witch is over, but Bazira still seems eager to send you on more exploration missions. Explore the Jewel Witch's realm and push your limits.
The mirror world has collapsed, but its fragments still remain. When you're ready, head there to explore and push your limits.

When used, deals damage to all enemies in range.
When used, moves to the opposite side of the Target and deals damage to all enemies in range.

When used, creates a `Sewing Wheel` near you that tracks the nearest enemy and continuously deals damage to all enemies in range.

When used, performs a `Rush` over a set distance, deals damage to all enemies in range, and fires `Needles`. Using it again within `{$Pull_Duration}s` pulls targets connected by `Thread` and deals additional damage increased by `{$Pull_Damage_More:0.##%}`.
Move SPD increases while `Charging`. When `Charging` ends, deals damage to all enemies in range based on the `Charged Gauge` and summons `{$Flower_SpawnAmount_PerCharge}` `Flower` per `Charge Level`.
When used, fires a projectile that deals damage to all enemies it pierces and summons `{$SpawnBasicCrow}` `Crow`.

When used, creates a `Blood Marble` that deals `{$DamagePerSec_Mult:0.##%} per second` DMG to all enemies in range. Every `{$Periodic_Period:0.##}s`, it creates `{$Periodic_BloodPickup_SpawAmount:0.##}` `Blood Clot` and deals DMG.

When `Charging` ends, fires a `Fireball` that deals damage to all enemies in range based on its `Charge Level`. If the Charge reaches `Level 1` or higher, it applies `Burn` equal to `{$FireDamage_DamageMult:0.##%}` of its `DMG Dealt`.

While `Channeling`, fires projectiles that deal damage to every enemy they pierce. When channeling ends, recalls the projectiles and deals damage again. Each projectile hit recovers the Cooldown of other Cooldown Skills.
